title: A Fixed Ring from an NTTP
prompt: Finish `Ring<N>`: `push` writes at `head_ % N` and advances `head_` (wrapping is the point), `capacity()` returns `N`. The test wraps around the buffer edge to prove it.

tests.name: capacity is the NTTP
tests.code:
static_assert(Ring<4>::capacity() == 4, "N from the type");
static_assert(Ring<64>::capacity() == 64, "N from the type");
tests.hint: static constexpr std::size_t capacity() { return N; } — N is part of the type.

tests.name: push wraps at the edge
tests.hint: void push(int v) { data_[head_ % N] = v; ++head_; } — the 4th push overwrites slot 0.
